term: property entailment as modal universal inclusion in A8
definition: A8P1 describes a property as a term, concept or abstract entity characterizing whatever has it. Its entails title says necessarily anything characterized by X is characterized by Y. A8C uses that modal universal inclusion and A8C2 explicitly allows necessarily false antecedents to entail vacuously. This is not relevant, causal, explanatory or independently nontrivial consequence.
note: No complete formal property domain, actualist/possibilist quantification or selected correspondence with Kripke Property/Box fields is established. A9’s nontrivial-entailment distinction is not silently substituted. Existing Scott positivity uses a separate classifier and global closure/exclusion axioms; no equivalence or complement-exclusion bridge is supplied.
